description: Same-event native extension contract for constructing a checked Rust schema-4 MargData record, including explicitly proven deletion-only native KF transitions.

native_absent: Rust four-way row_counts and source-to-Rust row permutation
Rust kf_to_marg destination/reanchor relation when native performs deletion-only host removal

required_bindings: same run_uuid/event ordinal/event state timestamp/packet filename+SHA
same native executable and library SHA
prior order with event-bound native order SHA, frame IDs, and explicit pose/state/state_pose block kinds

PriorData.fej_point f32 values plus every raw f32 bit word, either from a same-event native internal capture or a deterministically recomputed native frame-state-map projection whose source-map SHA is bound
four canonical row segments [prior, visual, imu, bias] with source and target starts
one explicit destination timestamp/frame for every selected source KF, or an explicit native_absent deletion-only proof with no fabricated pair
rust_extension_capture.no_synthesis_rule: Zero-fill, guessed row splits, or guessed reanchor destinations are invalid. A FEJ projection is accepted only when the exact same-event native frame-state maps, chart, order, and source-map SHA are present and independently recomputed by the validator. A deletion-only native transition is represented by status native_absent, empty pairs, source timestamps, operation remove_selected_hosts_and_observations, and a hash-bound full-event proof.

row_order.required_operation: apply the captured source-to-target permutation to Q2 rows while preserving column-major f32 values

prior_mapping.pose: translation xyz followed by quaternion xyz tangent lanes; quaternion w remains in frame sidecar
prior_mapping.state_pose: the first six pose lanes of a fifteen-DoF state block, resolved through frame_states and never coerced to a full state
prior_mapping.state: pose six lanes followed by velocity, gyro bias, accel bias
prior_mapping.oracle: prefer direct same-event PriorData.fej_point capture; when native cereal has no PriorData field, require the bound native frame-state-map projection and raw f32 bits to be recomputed exactly by the validator

schema4_representability.rule: A six-DoF prior block must resolve to either frame_poses (pose) or frame_states (state_pose); a fifteen-DoF block must resolve to frame_states (state). state_pose always consumes the first six lanes of the matching fifteen-DoF state block and does not synthesize a pose table.
schema4_representability.event0_observation: The pinned post-shift prior has a six-DoF block at the timestamp mapped to frame 49, while frame 49 exists only in frame_states as a fifteen-DoF state; it is therefore encoded explicitly as state_pose.
schema4_representability.required_action: Carry the explicit state_pose kind through the Rust wire and mapper/window prior mapping; reject missing, table-mismatched, or dimension-mismatched kinds.

acceptance.mapper_boundary: load_margdata_directory validation and write_mapper_packet_json only after checked deserialization
acceptance.round_trip: canonical JSON parse/serialize exact; Rust checked deserialize and mapper replay are separate required oracles

current_fixture.reason: same-event extension binds Q2/prior matrices, FEJ frame-state projection, row permutation, explicit state_pose mapping for native frame 49, and a deletion-only native transition with no fabricated destination

numeric_scope: Converter/validation only; no estimator arithmetic, FEJ update, AOM factor order, or mapper lifecycle change.
